### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **1** documentable anchor(s).

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via NavigationConfigSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **68** of **251** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **175** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0d727b70716ccf77fd63d0a0a2f0b17f7ab4d28a` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `4addfe0c961b354a382acfc6c3506cb3af6ef521` — the merge of head `495e0771f3037cfef01a02ee76d1808843d903a9` into base `0d727b70716ccf77fd63d0a0a2f0b17f7ab4d28a`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 4addfe0c961b354a382acfc6c3506cb3af6ef521 && git checkout 4addfe0c961b354a382acfc6c3506cb3af6ef521
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 0d727b70716ccf77fd63d0a0a2f0b17f7ab4d28a 495e0771f3037cfef01a02ee76d1808843d903a9 && git checkout -B drift-repro 0d727b70716ccf77fd63d0a0a2f0b17f7ab4d28a && git merge --no-ff 495e0771f3037cfef01a02ee76d1808843d903a9

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0d727b70716ccf77fd63d0a0a2f0b17f7ab4d28a
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 0d727b70716ccf77fd63d0a0a2f0b17f7ab4d28a` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2148b95b0772cffc9778b98ca0023f697fd443f8`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/view.form.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts + none

No file in the diff implements or enforces `navigation.size`: the renderers that resolve it (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordDrawerContext.ts`, `ui/packages/react/src/hooks/useNavigationOverlay.ts`, `ui/packages/plugin-view/src/recordSurface.ts`, `ui/packages/components/src/custom/navigation-overlay.tsx`, `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordDetailPanel.tsx`) are outside the diff and were read on `origin/main`, not reviewed. The remainder of the diff (the changeset, `content/docs/references/ui/{view,component}.mdx`, the en and zh-CN metadata-forms bundles, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/metadata-form-zh-cn.ts`) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`; it was read only for agreement with its source, below.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept set of `navigation.size`: unchanged — right. The `view.zod.ts` hunk leaves `z.enum(['auto', 'sm', 'md', 'lg', 'xl', 'full']).default('auto')` byte-identical; only the TSDoc block and the `.describe()` argument move. No key is added, removed, renamed, made optional or required; the default stays `'auto'`; `navigation.width` and `FormView.modalSize` are untouched.
- Public surface that does move: the `.describe()` string of `NavigationConfigSchema.size` (published in JSON Schema output, the reference pages and agent-facing descriptions) and the served form help text of the same key — right, and this is the whole of the card's ask.
- `view.form.ts`: one `helpText` string on the existing `size` field entry; no field added or removed, no widget or layout change — right. It is character-for-character the new `.describe()` (compared after unescaping the quotes), which is what `view-form-composite-children.test.ts` holds; Test Core is green on this head.
- Generated agreement, read not graded: the new describe sentence occurs 3 times in `view.mdx`, 7 times in `component.mdx` and once in `en.metadata-forms.generated.ts`, each identical to the source string; the string "derives from field count" no longer occurs under `packages`, `content` or `ui` at the head. The two zh-CN leaves are identical to each other and state the same facts as the English (fixed default, 460px console panel, 480/720/960/1200/1600 caps, drag wins, no effect as a page or on a phone-width screen). Check-runs `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Build Docs`, `Type Check · source gates` and `Spec property liveness` are success.

### ② Semver level

`patch` for `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/platform-objects` matches what the diff publishes: description text only, in the spec and in the English and zh-CN bundles that `platform-objects` ships. `Check Changeset` is success on the head.

Clause-②: `no` is correct. No accepted value set, default, key or schema shape moves in either direction; nothing an author could write before is refused now, and nothing new is accepted. `Metadata-protocol: none` is correct for the same reason. The line is the same on the PR body and in the changeset.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty in both dev reports; nothing to answer.
- Deviation, `view.form.ts` edited outside the first claim's file surface: answered — the claim amendment of 2026-11-23T11:27Z adds it, and the byte-equal pin makes the edit unavoidable once the describe moves.
- Deviation, `@objectstack/platform-objects` added to the changeset: answered — it ships the changed en and zh-CN bundles; correct.
- Dev out-of-scope flag, the deprecated `navigation.width` TSDoc says "kept only as a renderer fallback" while both resolvers let an authored `width` win over `size`: confirmed on `origin/main` (`recordPaneWidth` returns `nav.width` first, `resolveOverlayWidth` returns `navigation.width` first). Not in this diff; it belongs on its own card.
- Dev out-of-scope flag, stale renderer comments that still call the field-count derivation the `'auto'` path (`recordSurface.ts`, `useNavigationOverlay.ts`, `ui/e2e/toast-under-modal.spec.ts`): confirmed; comment-only, outside the diff.
- Not flagged by the dev, escalated to the seat: the patch round fixed the zh-CN help text, but nine sibling locale bundles under `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/` (ar, de, es-ES, fr, ja-JP, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-Hant, each `LOCALE.metadata-forms.generated.ts`, key `navigation.size`) still serve the retired sentence at this head — read in de, ja-JP and zh-Hant: "the renderer derives it from field count + viewport; AI writes nothing". They are translated leaves that no gate re-reads, exactly the case the claim amendment gave for zh-CN. They are outside the diff and outside this record's graded scope; the card's acceptance ("the generated references agree") is met for the references, so this is a follow-up card for the seat to file, not a finding on this head.
- SQL push-down: not applicable — the diff has no query, no id materialisation and no join.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`, each new sentence against `origin/main`:

- "Each explicit bucket is a pixel cap the renderer clamps to the viewport (`min(92vw, CAP)`): sm 480, md 720, lg 960, xl 1200, full 1600" — holds. `OVERLAY_SIZE_PX` in `plugin-view/src/recordSurface.ts` and `OVERLAY_SIZE_WIDTHS` in `react/src/hooks/useNavigationOverlay.ts` carry exactly these five caps in exactly this form.
- "`'auto'` is the host's fixed default width, the same for every object whatever its field count — nothing is derived from the object's fields" — holds. `recordPaneWidth` returns `RECORD_PREVIEW_DEFAULT_WIDTH` for an absent or `'auto'` size before it ever calls `overlayWidthFor`; `resolveOverlayWidth` returns `undefined` for `'auto'`. `deriveOverlaySize` survives only behind `overlayWidthFor`'s own `'auto'` branch, and the single non-test caller of `overlayWidthFor` (`recordPaneWidth`) never passes `'auto'`. The old sentence was false; the new one is true.
- "The console's record side panel (opened from an object's list, and the drawer level over a record page) opens at `min(92vw, 460px)`" — holds for the two surfaces it names: `objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` and `recordDrawerStack.tsx` both take `recordPaneWidth`, and `RECORD_PREVIEW_DEFAULT_WIDTH` is `'min(92vw, 460px)'`.
- "a page block's drawer opens at that block's own default (`min(960px, 60vw)` for the grid, kanban, calendar, gantt and tree; 42rem for the list, gallery, map and timeline)" — holds. The first five pass `navigation.width ?? RECORD_OVERLAY_DEFAULT_WIDTH` (`'min(960px, 60vw)'`); the other four spread the hook result into `NavigationOverlay`, whose fallback is `resolveWidth(width) ?? '42rem'`.
- "A width the reader drags is remembered and wins over both `'auto'` and a bucket" — holds: `paneWidthCss` takes the remembered `resize.width` before the host width. The remembered width is bounded to the 380–900 px drag range, which the sentence does not contradict.
- "no effect where the record opens as a page ... (in the console every record opens as a page on a phone), nor on a phone-width screen, where a block's drawer fills the screen" — holds: on a phone `objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` returns only `deriveRecordSurface(objectDef, { viewport: 'mobile' })`, which answers `'page'`, and carries no width; below the `sm` breakpoint the drawer is `w-screen max-w-none` and the width variable is applied only from `sm` up.
- The dropped clause "aligned with `FormView.modalSize`" was untrue on main: `modalSize` is `sm | default | lg | xl | full` (no `auto`, no `md`, an extra `default`) and `ModalForm.tsx` maps it to `max-w-sm`, `max-w-lg`, `max-w-2xl`, `max-w-5xl` and `95vw` — other names and other widths than the drawer buckets. Removing it is correct, and `modalSize` itself is untouched.
- The `.describe()` string is a faithful shortening of the TSDoc: every clause in it (fixed default, 460px console panel, the five caps, drag wins, prefer over `width`, no effect as a page or on a phone-width screen) is one of the sentences verified above.

`packages/spec/src/ui/view.form.ts`: the help text is the describe string verbatim, so every judgment above carries over; the entry stays under the same `navigation` group next to `width`, whose own text still points authors at `size`.

Attempt to break it: I looked for a host where `'auto'` still reaches the field-count path (none), a host where a bucket resolves to a different cap (none), and a console record drawer that is not 460. The last one exists, and gives the nits:

- N1 (nit) — two console hosts open a record side drawer without reading `navigation.size` at all: `ObjectDataPage.tsx` (the `/data` route) and `InterfaceListPage.tsx` both call `useNavigationOverlay` with a bare `{ mode }`, so their drawer is the `NavigationOverlay` fallback, 42rem, whatever is authored. The TSDoc's parenthesis scopes the 460 px claim to the object list and the record-page drawer level, so no sentence is false; the "no effect" paragraph is simply not exhaustive, and the short describe's "the console's record side panel opens at 460px" reads a little wider than the TSDoc. No effect on the contract. The real defect is the renderer not honouring the key on those hosts, which is a card of its own, not a text fix here.
- N2 (nit) — the published describe now quotes one host's constants (460px, and in the TSDoc `min(960px, 60vw)` and 42rem). Nothing ties the text to `RECORD_PREVIEW_DEFAULT_WIDTH` or `RECORD_OVERLAY_DEFAULT_WIDTH`: the pins on main hold the code, not the sentence, so the next change of a default leaves the describe stale the same way this card found it. The card asked for exactly this precision, so it is accepted as written; a parity pin is follow-up material.
- N3 (nit) — outside the diff, `packages/spec/src/data/record-surface.ts` ("Maps onto `navigation.size` / `FormView.modalSize`") and `ui/packages/plugin-view/src/recordSurface.ts` ("mirrors spec `NavigationConfig.size` / `FormView.modalSize`") still pair the two keys the diff has just stopped calling aligned. Comment-only; same follow-up as the stale comments the dev listed.

All three are left as accepted deviations or follow-up cards; none is fixed on this head.

## 席位核对

Verdict: **ACCEPT** at head `2148b95b0772cffc9778b98ca0023f697fd443f8` (read 2026-11-23T14:27Z).

1. **Shape.** Open, draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #36468`; the card's two asks (measure `'auto'`, rewrite TSDoc and describe and regenerate references) are both delivered, so `Fixes` is right. No closing keyword binds another card. `mergeable_state: clean`.
2. **Premise measured.** The old sentence ("renderer derives from field count + viewport") is gone from every shipped surface on the head: `git grep` finds it only in the historical `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` and `packages/lint/CHANGELOG.md` entries, which are records and stay. The renderer facts the new text states are judged in the L2 record (item 6).
3. **Gates at this head (check-runs).** 63 success · 11 expected skip · 0 unexpected skip · 0 failed · 0 pending; Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check both `success` (`l1-face.mjs --pr 36685`, clean on all 13 items). The earlier red on `7a0c1ee4` is a superseded head, not counted.
4. **Accepted deviations.** File surface: the claim was amended in comment 7099684159 before the patch round to add `view.form.ts` (help text pinned byte-equal to the describe), the generated references and en bundle, and the two zh-CN leaves; every file in the diff is inside the amended surface. Generated text: `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx` and `component.mdx` rows and the `en.metadata-forms.generated.ts` leaf are byte-equal to the new `.describe()`. The two zh-CN leaves (platform bundle and console overlay) are identical to each other and state the same facts as the English sentence, read clause by clause. Changeset read sentence by sentence against the diff: true, including "Prose only: the key, its values and its default are unchanged" (the `z.enum([...]).default('auto')` line is untouched). Both published packages touched carry a `patch` entry.
5. **Out of scope.** Owed ONE follow-up card by the area (filing gate), not fixed here because this diff does not touch those files: (a) nine other locale bundles in `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/` (ar, de, es-ES, fr, ja-JP, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-Hant) still serve the retired "derives from field count" sentence under `navigation.size` (seat read all nine at the head); (b) L2 N1: the `/data` route (`ObjectDataPage.tsx`) and `InterfaceListPage.tsx` open the console record drawer with a bare `{ mode }`, so `navigation.size` is not honoured there (42rem); (c) L2 N3 and the dev's flags: comments in `record-surface.ts` and `plugin-view/src/recordSurface.ts` still pair `size` with `FormView.modalSize`, the `navigation.width` TSDoc says "renderer fallback" though `width` wins, and the renderer comments on the `'auto'` path are stale. The dropped "aligned with `FormView.modalSize`" clause: removal only; the `modalSize` retirement is #36544, untouched here. `Skills-docs:` not owed (`Metadata-protocol: none`, no narrowing arm).
6. **Landing.** Contract face: `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` and `view.form.ts` are the published-schema face, so an L2 at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` is owed. L2 record: PR #36685 comment 7104020332 — `Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, head `2148b95b0772cffc9778b98ca0023f697fd443f8`, `Scope:` equals the `hits` (`view.zod.ts`, `view.form.ts`), tier verified on the reviewer's transcript, **PASS**, no must-fix or should-fix; every new sentence checked against the renderers on `main`, and the dropped `modalSize` clause confirmed untrue. Its nits N1–N3 are accepted as is and go to the follow-up card in item 5. Not governed; no `content/docs/releases/` path. Land on this head; any head move needs a fresh read.
